purpose: Track what world information exists, where it may be propagating, and whether Arlequino or important NPCs have causally received it.

items.subject: Destruction of the Eurazania capital on T+161
items.exposure_event: At a caravan-dispatch/merchant-information counter in Dwargon, a clerk reports that the Eurazania capital was destroyed on T+161 after Milim's attack.

items.subject: Carrion publicly presumed defeated/dead after the T+161 clash
items.exposure_event: After Arlequino asks whether the king is dead, the caravan clerk says reports claim Carrion was defeated and is presumed dead, while explicitly lacking official confirmation or proof.
items.restricted_truth: Carrion's true survival must not be exposed before canonical revelation.

items.subject: Where Eurazania evacuees were sent and where they are currently located
items.anti_invention: Do not choose a destination without a causal source.

items.subject: Condition of 18 Old Garden Street after the destruction of the Eurazania capital
items.anti_invention: Capital destruction does not by itself establish the exact state of this specific address.

update_rules.on_new_source: Add source/channel/time/recipient and update confidence without erasing contradictory rumors.
update_rules.on_player_exposure: Persist the exact exposure; world truth and player belief remain separate fields.
update_rules.on_official_correction: Preserve earlier rumor history, mark it corrected/superseded rather than pretending it never circulated.
update_rules.future_events: Do not insert before they occur in world time.
